item.title: Syllabus
item.description: Course syllabus for Python Programming — Planet Leads Academy.

item.title: Setup and Your First Program
item.description: Learn Python from your first line of code to building real automation scripts and projects. Lesson 1: Setup and Your First Program This lesson gets Python running on your computer and teaches you to run your first program. By the end you will know how to check whether Python is already installed…

item.title: Data Types, Operators, and User Input
item.description: Lesson 2: Data Types, Operators, and User Input This lesson teaches you the building blocks every Python program is made of: the main data types, the operators that combine them, and how to get input from the person using your program. By the end you will know the difference between strings…

item.title: Control Flow — Decisions and Loops
item.description: Lesson 3: Control Flow — Decisions and Loops This lesson teaches your programs to make decisions and repeat work — the two abilities that turn a calculator into a real program. By the end you will write if/elif/else statements that choose between paths, for loops that repeat a fixed number of times…

item.title: Functions — Reusable Blocks of Code
item.description: Lesson 4: Functions — Reusable Blocks of Code This lesson teaches you to package code into functions: named, reusable blocks that take inputs and produce outputs. By the end you will define functions with def, pass data in through parameters, send results back with return, and understand the…

item.title: Lists, Dictionaries, Tuples, and Sets
item.description: Lesson 5: Lists, Dictionaries, Tuples, and Sets This lesson teaches you Python's four core collection types — containers that hold multiple values. By the end you will create and manipulate lists, look up values in dictionaries by key, understand when tuples and sets are the right choice, and loop…

item.title: Files and Error Handling
item.description: Lesson 6: Files and Error Handling This lesson teaches your programs to remember things between runs by reading and writing files, and to survive problems gracefully with error handling. By the end you will open, read, and write text files using the with statement; store structured data with JSON…

item.title: Automation Project — Build a File Organizer
item.description: Lesson 7: Automation Project — Build a File Organizer This lesson is your first real project: an automation script that organizes a messy folder for you, sorting files into subfolders by type. By the end you will have planned a script before coding it, used the os and shutil modules to inspect and…

item.title: Capstone — Expense Tracker CLI and Where to Go Next
item.description: Lesson 8: Capstone — Expense Tracker CLI and Where to Go Next This final lesson puts the whole course together in one capstone project: a command-line expense tracker that adds expenses, lists them, shows totals, and saves everything to a file so nothing is lost when the program closes. By the end…
